notes: Page 0 only (manifest scored_pages). Excluded: PICA alignment boxes; items reserved for NUCC use (8, 9b, 9c, 30); the 24H shaded (EPSDT referral) cell; pre-printed 'NPI' in 24I. Cells are their writing area below the printed caption (lower data line), inset 1pt. Date groups are one box per MM/DD/YY group; money boxes are split at the printed dollars|cents divider; phones are split at the printed parentheses. 24 is a 6-row table: per row 18 lower cells, the shaded supplemental strip (24A-24G), and shaded 24I qualifier / 24J other ID. 32 and 33 multi-line areas are one box each. Diagnosis B-L are pathless (the schema keeps them as an array of scalar codes; only A maps to principal_diagnosis_code).
